title.description: The title of the academy article. Should be concise and informative, reflecting the article's main topic.

description.description: A brief, engaging description of the academy article. This description is used in search results and article previews.

author.description: The author of the academy article. Use the full name of the author.

date.description: The date the academy article was published. Use the ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

tags.description: Keywords related to the academy article. Use a maximum of 10 tags.

duration.description: The estimated reading time of the article (e.g., '15 minutes').

level.description: The level of the academy article (e.g., Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced).

category.description: The category of the academy article (e.g., Amazon SEO, Product Research).
